entries.label: Battery pack, protection, charger, motor distribution and harness
entries.specification: Protected 3S1P power architecture candidate; no installed CAD part IDs. Crosswise RRC-sized body passes the retained neutral packaging screen; connectors/retention remain absent. Published 4 A/8 A smart packs do not cover the sizing demand; shared-source all-rated cases reach 15.354/15.955 A, exceeding the current 15 A allocation; a 9.6 V source with 8 A motor demand fails motor voltage. See docs/design/battery-packaging.md and docs/design/shared-battery.md. A separate 14-component motor-disconnect candidate has compiled connections and static divider evidence; its BOM remains on hold with zero installed quantity and unquoted 1,000/5,000-unit prices.
entries.price_note: Existing $30–60 per-robot range is an unquoted planning assumption; no retail or volume quote.
